name: Online Co-op
author: Jeffiest
description: Play Dark Cloud together online, up to four. The host plays their own save and opens a room; friends join it from the title screen's Online Co-op with its code and walk into the host's world: the host's story, towns, Georama and dungeons, with their own weapons, items and Gilda, which the host's save keeps for them. A friend's own save is never touched. A dropped guest gets back in by itself; each player's ping is on the HUD. A player knocked out is down, not out: a friend beside them revives them, and a party that all falls walks back to town with its things. Needs the MoonFactory engine with online play (net.*) and visits.

settings.name: Your name, as the others see it
